notes.manas-2010:p0354:b001:l004: Уялуу коргон rendered nested fortifications; no modern Beijing geography inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0354:b001:l012: Аяр: cunning/occult expertise; craftier is broad English, alongside explicit second sight in l017.
notes.manas-2010:p0354:b001:l019: Эсеби жок: beyond reckoning retained; may concern his numerous resources as well as ability.
notes.manas-2010:p0354:b001:l025: Эки эмес order-not-twice idiom, not two contradictory orders.
notes.manas-2010:p0354:b001:l033: Карыпчы armor protecting arm, supported by Manas encyclopedia entry at https://el-sozduk.kg/КАРЫПЧЫ/.
notes.manas-2010:p0354:b001:l040: Арман болбойт мендеде narratorial abundance formula; syntactic attachment provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0354:b001:l042: Narrator explicitly questions truth; repeated uncertainty and absence of eyewitnesses preserved through l047.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l002: One thousand here, seven thousand l012/l041; source figures preserved without harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l008: Eye cannot encompass army; not literal invisibility.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l018: Көсөп aimed/piercing shot provisional; firearm versus arrow not specified by English shots.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l023: Forty households is source opponent count, not army strength.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l030: Билериктүү dark rings on horses legs per Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/билерик/; кулача dun per https://el-sozduk.kg/кулач/. Next line сур gray retained despite color overlap.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l032: Чөйчөк семиз: fat horse with hollow between swollen sides of rump; Yudakhin чөйчөк ал- at https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&word=чөйчөк. Кур idle/unworked horse, dictionary https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lang=kg&lfrom=xx&word=КУР.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l043: Керик rhinoceros retained as epic exotic transport; payload unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0355:b001:l045: Калдай historical administrative rank, broadly governors; https://el-sozduk.kg/калдай/.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l005: Visible тос interpreted as тоз dust: 2015 explanatory dictionary quotes the exact formula Топурак учуп, тоз күйүп from Karalaev Semetey under dispersing/dust sense; Yudakhin тоз II fine dust. https://el-sozduk.kg/тоз/. Burning metaphor retained as blazed; raw spelling preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l011: Карып кылып overwhelmed/devastated in flood context; does not mean travelers here.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l015: Mustafa is prophetic epithet/name in source; holy renders ак; no substitution of a modern narrator.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l019: Кутпа жак north, not qibla; explicit Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/КУТПА/.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l020: Ынсабы калың retained as much restraint; source lacks ыйман (faith). Do not silently negate first phrase to harmonize.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l022: Visible карап interpreted as ruin (compare карып earlier); draft contextual reading, raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l026: Эңкейтип сурак албаган rendered no one made it bow for questioning, a subjection formula; exact subject linkage provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0356:b001:l038: Жанказан large cauldron; exact subtype uncertain.
